name: lucy
description: A personal AI assistant over iMessage and Slack, deployed on your own accounts - Gmail, Calendar, reminders with follow-through, memory, and a diary. Built on eve.

paragraphs: Lucy is a personal assistant that lives in iMessage and Slack, deployed entirely on accounts you own. She reads and triages your Gmail, manages your Google Calendar and Tasks, schedules reminders that follow up until you actually do the thing, books restaurant reservations (including sniping tables the second they drop), keeps long-term memory, and quietly maintains a diary of your life. No third-party assistant product in the loop: your deployment, your database, your API keys, and your data live in your own Vercel, Supabase, and Google accounts. Built on eve (Vercel's durable-agent framework), Sendblue (iMessage), Vercel Connect (OAuth brokering), and Supabase (Postgres).
features: iMessage channel - text a number, get an assistant. Free Sendblue sandbox works (fast-polling ingress, 10–20s replies, read receipts, typing indicators, Unicode-bold rendering since iMessage has no markdown). A dormant…
Slack channel - instant DMs via eve's built-in Slack channel; human-in-the-loop approvals render as real buttons.

Reminders with follow-through - natural language in, DST-proof scheduling out (daily, weekly, weekdays, monthly, everyNdays). One-off reminders stay open until you confirm; silence earns up to three nudges on a widening…

Gmail - search, read (quoted-history stripped), and send/reply. Sends are always approval-gated, and email content is treated as untrusted input (the persona explicitly refuses instructions embedded in emails). Email…

Google Calendar + Tasks - list, create, and update events, manage the default task list. One OAuth grant covers all three Google services. Events can carry guests: pass attendees and Google sends the real invitations,…

Resy's OTP login is three steps, and two of them are counter-intuitive.
Note also that OTP login returns no refresh token; the 45-day/90-day pair the community Go clients document belongs to the password flow, which an OTP-only account (hassetpassword: 0) can't use.
